prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Sr. Data Engineer (AWS Redshift, Glue) - Remote
We are looking for skilled Sr. Data Engineer (AWS Redshift, Glue) - Remote with 6+ years of experience on contract (remote) for 6 months. The selected candidate would have to work remotely with team in India during India office hours 9:00 am to 6:00 pm (5 days a week). Our Budget: INR 1,00,000 per month Required Skill Sets: 1. Candidate should have extensive experience in Glue, Redshift, SQL Consultant on Contract 2. Experience in managing / administration of Redshift, Athena, Glue - Should have exposure to ETL 3. Good understanding of cloud and AWS 4. The candidate should have sound knowledge in Database and Database Warehousing
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Inventory reconciliation automation
client: Coastline Hardware
client_industry: wholesale
start: 2021-10
end: 2021-12
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Excel
- Power Query
- SQL
built: A Power Query workbook that matches warehouse counts to the ERP every week
  and flags variances.
metrics:
- $86k of stock variance found
- weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Inventory reconciliation automation (p04).
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, a data analyst with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’m interested in your Sr. Data Engineer role and can support SQL-heavy data work, ETL-related analysis, and warehouse reporting in a remote setup during India office hours. In a past project, I built a Power Query workbook for Coastline Hardware that matched warehouse counts to the ERP every week and flagged variances. It found $86k of stock variance and reduced weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

I’m comfortable working with structured data, cleaning messy datasets, and building reliable reporting workflows. If you’re looking for someone detail-oriented and strong in SQL and reporting, I’d be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
